days.headline: Typed Slots Meet Unified Portfolio Search
days.summary: Across the portfolio, github-portfolio-search unified search over the project corpus and per-project docs while regenerating pages with integrated navigation. In riff, the day focused on typed slot extraction: a semantic slot-type registry, build-time lint gates and ratchets, migrations for names/phones/times/addresses/quantities/emails, DateExpr ambiguity handling, readback fixes, and eval holdouts/fallbacks.
takeaways: Use a shared project corpus as the search index, then wire per-project docs and nav into generated pages for portfolio-wide discovery.
Move extraction logic behind semantic slot types, starting with a registry/loader gate and migrating flows in batches with baseline counts to track progress.
Add typed adapters for tricky intents like dates, email, address, and quantity so validation, ambiguity blocking, and readback can live close to the type.
Gate conversational changes with held-out persona splits and a live judge fallback so evals test generalization instead of only tuned paths.

days.headline: Riff Hardens Flow Evaluation With Lints, Backstops, and Failover
days.summary: Riff shipped a broad reliability pass for flow evaluation: provider timeouts, wall-clock deadlines, Gemini-to-Alibaba failover, qwen-max escalation, incremental transcript persistence, and no-progress loop backstops. The same day also closed concrete conversation defects around delivery addresses, appointment times, stale re-asks, raw container read-backs, denial wording, branch-aware scoring, and local security-report hygiene in github-portfolio-search.
takeaways: Added static and trace lints for one-beat turns, invalid final statuses, missing scheduler times, missing delivery addresses, and raw repr read-backs; reuse them as preflight gates before expensive eval sweeps.

Built eval runtime backstops with hard request timeouts, per-conversation deadlines, provider failover, transcript checkpointing, and model escalation on repeated stalls; apply the pattern to keep LLM test harnesses from hanging or losing evidence.

Tightened slot-filling behavior with slot-specific reprompts, read-back after fills/corrections/front-loads, branch-aware fill-rate scoring, and distinct denial language; reuse these as state-machine invariants for conversational agents.
Closed domain-specific flow gaps in pizza, coffee, dental, grooming, tutoring, salon, and apartment scheduling flows; pair transcript audits with static checks for required branch-specific slots.

days.headline: Reusable Flow Evaluator Lands With Read-Back Runtime Fixes
days.summary: Riff gained a full flow-evaluation stack: typed specs, goal derivation, persona-driven conversation runs, scoring rubrics, reports, CLI access, transcripts, fast no-judge mode, and robust judge parsing. The same sweep hardened runtime flow behavior with real slot read-backs, guarded fallback logic, post-confirmation acknowledgements, silent-terminal linting, and text-mode support for audio-gated flows.
takeaways: Reuse the evaluator shape: flow -> derive goals/personas -> drive conversations -> score -> emit versioned markdown/JSON reports.
Expose evaluation both as a public `evaluate()` API and a CLI with `--describe`/`--no-judge` so agents and humans can run the same harness at different speeds.
Make LLM judging resilient with explicit errored states, stop reasons, transcript persistence, balanced-brace JSON parsing, and heuristic-fallback notes.
Prevent canned or silent endings by formatting actual slot read-backs, gating fallbacks on non-empty summaries, and linting silent success terminals.

days.headline: Grounding Gates Gain Diagnostics, Tests, and Safer CI
days.summary: Riff advanced a deterministic grounding-gate system from design through shadow wiring to offered-then-affirmed checks, with failure classification, surface-form matching, logging, diagnostics, docs, and tests. github-portfolio-search tightened automation by standardizing docs and reindex workflows on GHPS_PAT and adding a nightly reindex schedule.
takeaways: Build deterministic gates first: Riff landed a pure Phase 0 gate with word-boundary matching, hardened types, design notes, and tests.
Roll out behavior safely: use observe-only shadow wiring behind a kill switch, then promote offered-then-affirmed logic to reduce shadow false positives.
Make gate demos reusable: support bare python3 from any directory, --list-flows, per-run JSONL logs, and --review diagnostics.
Harden CI secrets consistently: share one repo-scoped PAT across generated docs and reindex jobs, then schedule reindexing nightly.

days.headline: Self-Documenting Portfolio Pipeline Lands With Safer LLM Docs
days.summary: A new L0 portfolio-docs pipeline now fetches GitHub hygiene signals, assembles per-repo context, generates validated structured records through provider-agnostic LLM support, and renders them into HTML plus an aggregate projects feed. The work also hardened rendering, batching, JSON extraction, Mermaid diagrams, and documentation pages so the generated portfolio output is safer and easier to reuse.
takeaways: Use a small record schema plus validator before publishing LLM output; this keeps generated portfolio data predictable and testable.
Abstract LLM calls behind a provider-agnostic client for DashScope and Anthropic so docs generation can switch providers without rewriting the pipeline.
Render structured records as HTML with a JSON island and Mermaid, but escape script, ld+json, and pre content to avoid XSS breakouts.
Aggregate per-project records into web/data/projects.json and expose a CLI orchestrator with env scaffolding for repeatable portfolio generation.
